title: run_code result
description: The same six fields for every outcome, including failure. A timeout is exitCode 124 with timedOut true, not an error envelope: the candidate's code hanging is data about the candidate, not a system fault, and the model must be able to reason about it as such.

exitCode.description: 124 when the sandbox killed the process on timeout.

truncated.description: True when stdout or stderr hit the 4000-character cap.

durationMs.description: Wall clock inside the sandbox, excluding container start.
